market_summary.summary: Philippines remains one of the strongest and most mature markets in the zone. The studio is already operating at a high level and has strengthened the team further, including bringing in a more experienced creative content lead to push the work beyond operational excellence and into more creative-led output. The biggest opportunity now is not structure, but raising the level of creative ambition and the quality of briefs coming in. The current capability base is strong enough to support this.
market_summary.desired_outcome: Philippines should move from being a strong strategic performer to becoming a stronger creative benchmark for the zone, translating its strong orchestration and effectiveness into more iconic, idea-led work.
market_summary.nestle_next_step: The key ask is not more output, but better briefs. Nestlé needs to push the brands toward more creatively inspired, more ambitious briefing, especially if the expectation is for the studio to drive stronger brand-building work and not just high-quality delivery.
market_summary.wpp_next_step: Keep pushing the studio from strong orchestration into stronger creative leadership. Support the new creative leadership setup, sharpen co-creation ways of working, and convert the market’s strong operational base into more distinctive, idea-led work. Continue codifying best practices so Philippines can remain a benchmark market in the zone.
market_summary.wpp_poc: Maan De Los Reyes / Rusty Orga
market_summary.source_ref: AoA Studios Status Update - Thailand.xlsx · Summary Wk Apr 20!4

market_summary.summary: Thailand has positive momentum. The market recently won the creator business, and the key task now is integrating that into the current studio scope in a practical and sustainable way. At the same time, there is still uncertainty around the half-year scope, which is slowing down clarity on resourcing and planning. This is a market with strong momentum, but some basic decisions are still pending.
market_summary.desired_outcome: Thailand should evolve into a more integrated studio model where creator, content, and strategy work together more naturally. The opportunity is strong, but it now needs scope and workflow stability to scale.
market_summary.nestle_next_step: Nestlé needs to finalize the half-year scope as soon as possible. Without that, it is difficult to plan properly, especially now that the creator business has been added and the studio model is becoming more complex.
market_summary.wpp_next_step: Integrate the newly won creator scope properly into the existing studio setup and make sure the model supports this rather than running it in parallel. WPP should also continue tightening the way the studio works operationally so the market can scale the opportunity cleanly.
market_summary.source_ref: AoA Studios Status Update - Thailand.xlsx · Summary Wk Apr 20!9

executive_analysis.current_state: Thailand has positive momentum. The market recently won the creator business, and the key task now is integrating that into the current studio scope in a practical and sustainable way. At the same time, there is still uncertainty around the half-year scope, which is slowing down clarity on resourcing and planning. This is a market with strong momentum, but some basic decisions are still pending.
executive_analysis.desired_outcome: Thailand should evolve into a more integrated studio model where creator, content, and strategy work together more naturally. The opportunity is strong, but it now needs scope and workflow stability to scale.
executive_analysis.decision_focus: Finalize half year scope with clear priorities and expected volume
executive_analysis.primary_bottleneck: Complete first: Finalize half year scope with clear priorities and expected volume — Required support: Nestlé to align on workflow and expectations

market_summary.summary: Japan remains a rebuilding market. The key conversations now are around scope and team composition, not expansion. There is also a need to build more category expertise, particularly in coffee, while keeping the model realistic for the current phase of the market. The reset is still operational and structural before it becomes strategic.
market_summary.desired_outcome: Japan needs to move from rebuild to stability before it can move into a more strategic phase. The first priority is restoring the operating model, then rebuilding category depth and strategic confidence.
market_summary.nestle_next_step: Nestlé should align on a realistic scope and team expectation for Japan and avoid overloading the studio before the core model is rebuilt. The market also needs to support clearer category priorities so the team can be built around real business need.
market_summary.wpp_next_step: Continue working through the scope and team design. Clarify what the studio should actually cover now, and build the team around that, with a stronger category lens where needed, especially for coffee. Keep the focus on making the model stable and relevant before trying to scale ambition.
market_summary.source_ref: AoA Studios Status Update - Thailand.xlsx · Summary Wk Apr 20!7

market_summary.summary: MENA is under real pressure. Demand is growing, more brands are coming in, but the scope is not fully finalized and the budgeting is still unresolved. WPP is currently helping absorb demand by putting in offshore support, but this is not sustainable without proper ACP and client-side approvals. Since it is already Q2, this is now pressing. The issue is less about intent and more about getting the scope, PO, and financial structure finalized quickly.
market_summary.desired_outcome: MENA needs to evolve from reactive support into a properly structured studio model with the right production and delivery backbone. The ambition is there, but it needs commercial and operating clarity to stabilize.
market_summary.nestle_next_step: Nestlé needs to finalize the PO and ACP urgently so the market can budget and resource properly. The current demand profile is already ahead of the approved commercial setup, and that gap needs to be closed immediately.
market_summary.wpp_next_step: Continue supporting immediate demand through offshore help where necessary, but push for urgent scope finalization so the operating model can be stabilized. WPP also needs to define what is required to support the increased number of brands coming in, both from a resource and production standpoint.
market_summary.source_ref: AoA Transformation Checklist - MENA.xlsx · Summary Wk Apr 20!8

market_summary.summary: India is in a more active review phase. Beyond the capability assessment, there is now a broader audit happening around the briefs entering the studio, the true scope of work, and whether the current team is the right fit for that scope. A major focus is strengthening category expertise, particularly in confectionery, and making sure the studio and creative AOR are working in a shared and aligned way. This is as much about operating model clarity as it is about capability.
market_summary.desired_outcome: India needs to evolve into a more category-led and strategically aligned studio, especially around confectionery, with stronger upstream strategic role and clearer alignment between scope, team, and capability.
market_summary.nestle_next_step: Nestlé should assess whether the person leading the studio on the client side is the right fit for the capabilities now expected from the studio. There also needs to be clarity on what the studio is truly meant to own, so the work coming in is aligned to the model and not just flowing in by default.
market_summary.wpp_next_step: Complete the audit of incoming briefs and current scope. Review whether the team composition matches the actual demand profile. Build stronger category capability in confectionery inside the studio and make sure there is a shared way of working between the creative AOR and the studio so visual and brand basics are consistently met.
market_summary.source_ref: AoA Transformation Checklist - India.xlsx · Summary Wk Apr 20!5

market_summary.wpp_next_step: Support the market with tighter governance and clearer operating structure, especially if this is meant to become more than an execution setup. Focus on proving strategic value in a few selected areas instead of trying to shift the entire model at once.
